metadata.gitb:name: [us.fsma204] Validate an uploaded Digital Product Passport
metadata.gitb:description: Upload a passport as JSON-LD and validate it against the "us.fsma204" shapes (US FSMA 204 — FDA FSMA §204 Food Traceability Rule (21 CFR 1 Subpart S)). The passport's own @context is resolved from ref.openepcis.org, so it must reference the published contexts — the same condition a real consumer of the passport faces.

verify.desc: Validate against the us.fsma204 SHACL shapes

failure.default: "The passport does not conform to us.fsma204. The failed step's report lists every violation."
